## Functional requirements

### FR-001 — Book an appointment online **[Explicit]**

A patient books an appointment by choosing a dentist, a treatment type and a free time slot from the calendar.

- **Source:** US-001 · **Priority:** MUST (proposed) · **Phase:** MVP · **Status:** NEEDS_CLARIFICATION · **Confidence:** HIGH
- **Client's words:** "The patient picks a dentist, a treatment type and a free time slot from the calendar."
- **Business rules:** BR-001, BR-002 · **Depends on:** IR-001 · **Risks:** RISK-003
- **Open questions:** Q-002, Q-003, Q-004, Q-005, Q-007, Q-009 (see open-questions.md)
- **Why this priority:** This is the goal of US-001; without it the story delivers nothing.
- **Design:** https://www.figma.com/file/AbC123/Clinic-Booking?node-id=12-34 · designs/booking-mobile.png
- **Acceptance criteria:**
  - Given a patient on the booking page, when they select a dentist, treatment and free slot and confirm, then the appointment is saved and the slot is no longer shown as free.

### FR-002 — Send booking confirmation email **[Explicit]**

After a booking is saved, the patient receives a confirmation email stating the appointment date, time and dentist.

- **Source:** US-001 · **Priority:** SHOULD (proposed) · **Phase:** MVP · **Status:** NEEDS_CLARIFICATION · **Confidence:** HIGH
- **Client's words:** "After booking, the patient receives a confirmation email with the date, time and dentist."
- **Business rules:** — · **Depends on:** FR-001 · **Risks:** RISK-003
- **Open questions:** Q-005, Q-006, Q-008 (see open-questions.md)
- **Why this priority:** The client says patients "should" get a confirmation. Booking still works without it, but it is small and builds on FR-001, so it is proposed for MVP.
- **Design:** https://www.figma.com/file/AbC123/Clinic-Booking?node-id=12-34 · designs/booking-mobile.png
- **Acceptance criteria:**
  - Given a patient has confirmed a booking When the appointment is saved Then the patient receives an email showing the appointment date, time and dentist


## Non-functional requirements

### NFR-001 — Booking page load time **[Unknown]**

The booking page loads fast on desktop and mobile. The target load time is not stated.

- **Source:** US-001 · **Priority:** SHOULD (proposed) · **Phase:** MVP · **Status:** NEEDS_CLARIFICATION · **Confidence:** LOW
- **Client's words:** "The booking page should load fast, even on mobile."
- **Metric:** booking page load time on mobile · **Target:** UNKNOWN · **Measured by:** UNKNOWN — to be agreed with the client (see Q-001)
- **Business rules:** — · **Depends on:** FR-001 · **Risks:** RISK-004
- **Open questions:** Q-001 (see open-questions.md)
- **Why this priority:** The story says the page "should load fast". It is proposed for MVP because it measures FR-001, but it cannot be approved until Q-001 gives a target.
- **Acceptance criteria:** none yet


## Business rules

### BR-001 — Booking window of 24 hours to 60 days **[Explicit]**

An appointment can be booked only if its start time is at least 24 hours and at most 60 days after the moment of booking.

- **Source:** US-001 · **Priority:** MUST (proposed) · **Phase:** MVP · **Status:** PROPOSED · **Confidence:** HIGH
- **Client's words:** "Appointments can only be booked between 24 hours and 60 days in advance."
- **Rule category:** TIME_BASED
- **Business rules:** — · **Depends on:** — · **Risks:** —
- **Why this priority:** The client says bookings "can only" be made 24 hours to 60 days ahead, and FR-001 (MUST) is governed by it.
- **Acceptance criteria:**
  - Given a slot less than 24 hours away, when the patient views the calendar, then the slot cannot be selected.

### BR-002 — A booked slot is no longer free **[Explicit]**

Once an appointment is saved for a slot, that slot is no longer offered as free to any patient.

- **Source:** US-001 · **Priority:** MUST (proposed) · **Phase:** MVP · **Status:** PROPOSED · **Confidence:** HIGH
- **Client's words:** "the slot is no longer shown as free"
- **Rule category:** DATA_CONSTRAINT
- **Business rules:** — · **Depends on:** — · **Risks:** RISK-002
- **Why this priority:** FR-001 (MUST) is governed by it; without it a slot could be booked twice.
- **Acceptance criteria:**
  - Given a slot has just been booked, when another patient views the calendar, then that slot is not shown as free.


## Integration requirements

### IR-001 — Read availability from and write bookings to ClinicDesk **[Inferred]**

Online booking reads free slots from ClinicDesk and writes each confirmed appointment back to ClinicDesk.

- **Source:** US-001 · **Priority:** MUST (proposed) · **Phase:** MVP · **Status:** NEEDS_CLARIFICATION · **Confidence:** MEDIUM
- **Rationale:** CON-001 makes ClinicDesk the master calendar, so the free slots shown in FR-001 must come from ClinicDesk, and new bookings must land there or the calendars diverge.
- **Business rules:** — · **Depends on:** CON-001 · **Risks:** RISK-001, RISK-002
- **Open questions:** Q-008 (see open-questions.md)
- **Why this priority:** FR-001 (MUST) depends on it, and a MUST item's dependencies are MUST.
- **Acceptance criteria:** none yet


## Constraints

### CON-001 — ClinicDesk remains the master calendar **[Explicit]**

The existing practice-management system, ClinicDesk, stays the master calendar. The booking feature must not replace it.

- **Source:** US-001 · **Priority:** MUST (proposed) · **Phase:** MVP · **Status:** PROPOSED · **Confidence:** HIGH
- **Client's words:** "We must keep using our existing practice-management system (ClinicDesk) as the master calendar."
- **Business rules:** — · **Depends on:** — · **Risks:** RISK-001
- **Why this priority:** The client says "We must keep using" ClinicDesk; every booking design depends on it.
- **Acceptance criteria:** none yet
